t: Hayyashen im ishto ubanayv ek yitnaheg
s: Hayyashen im ishto ubanayv ek yitnaheg ubo g' seipim: shenayim shehem yeshenim arummim umitkassim betallit echad ubesar shenehem nogeim zeh bazeh — lo yiqra qeriat shema, ella im ken hayeta tallit mapseqet benehem mimmotnehem ulematta, mippene shennegiat besaram mimmotnehem ulematta mebia oto lide hirhur bishat qeriato, veasur mishshum "velo yireh beka ervat dabar". Veap al pi sheen hakkatub medabber ella beervato mammash keshehi megulla veniret kemo sheyyitbaer sham, mikkol maqom middibre soperim beshaa she"h' eloheka mithallek beqereb machaneka", dehaynu kesheoseq biqriat shema o bitpilla o betalmud tora kemo sheyyitbaer besiman a"d — kol dabar shemmebi lide hirhur niqra erva, kemo sheameru: tepach beishsha erva, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman a"h. Veap al pi (b) sheapillu laerva mammash moil kissuy — kan en kissuy moil, kevan shemmikkol maqom hu ba lide hirhur al yede shemmargish negiat besar chabero bibsaro mimmotnayim ulematta. Umittaam zeh aseru shemiat qol zemer ishsha shehi erva, ap al pi shehaqqol eno nireh ella nishma lo mebio lide hirhur, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman a"h. (Bammeh debarim amurim? (G) kesheqqore qeriat shema, o mitpallel, o medabber bedibre tora bepiv, abal leharher bedibre tora muttar apillu kesheervato mammash megulla, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman a"h. Kol shekken sheshshomea qol ishsha, o sheshshokeb im ishto beqerub basar apillu shello bachazarat panim, ap al pi sheasur liqrot bepiv kemo sheyyitbaer. Umittaam zeh muttar leharher bidbarim shebbeqdushshah bishat tashmish, shehirhur eno kedibbur leinyan zeh, ap al pi shehu kedibbur leinyan leharher bimboot hamtunnapot):

Hayeta ishto yeshena immo — en tzarik lehapsaqat tallit beno lebenah, mippene sheishto kegupo, shehoil sheragil bah lo yabo lide hirhur. Abal mikkol maqom eno qore ella bachazarat panim mimmenna, dehaynu sheyyachaziru shenehem achorehem zeh lazeh, kede shello yihyeh besarah nogea beervato o besaro beervatah veyabo lide hirhur. Veyesh mi sheoser ap beishto shello behapsaqat tallit. Venakon lachush lidbarayv:

Haya yashen im banayv beodam qetannim — muttar liqrot bachazarat panim belo hapsaqat tallit, sheen lachush shemma yabo lide hirhur mechamat negiat besar haqqetannim bibsaro, kol sheen besaro nogea beervatan velo besaram beervato. Veim hem gedolim — tzarik lehapsaqat tallit. Ad kamma hem chashubim qetannim? Hattinoq ad sheyyihyeh lo y"b shana, vehattinoqet ad shettihyeh lah y"a shana. Vaapillu hebiu b' searot betok zeman hazzeh — enan kelum. Ubishnat y"g lattinoq ushenat y"b lattinoqet, im hebiu b' searot — asur belo hapsaqat tallit, veim lav — muttar. Umishshenat y"g veelak lattinoq vy"b lattinoqet apillu lo hebiu b' searot — asur belo hapsaqat tallit:
